title: Administrator.
bodyText: The lieutenant governor shall be the officer who shall serve as central administrator and information agent for the Agreement on Detainers.
bodyHtml: §834-6  Administrator.  The lieutenant governor shall be the officer who shall serve as central administrator and information agent for the Agreement on Detainers. [L 1965, c 160, §6; Supp, §250A-6; HRS §714-6; ren L 1972, c 9, pt of §1]
